details: Bitcoin (BTC) dropped below $84,000, extending losses due to renewed inflation and interest rate hike concerns following the rise in US composite and services PMIs in September. Worldcoin (WLD) and Pepe (PEPE) experienced double-digit losses, emerging as the worst performers. The FedWatch Tool indicates a roughly 70% probability of a 25 basis point rate hike in October.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $84K on Rate Hike Concerns, Altcoins Suffer

details: BlackRock's IBIT spearheaded a $746 million outflow from spot Bitcoin ETFs over two days. This exodus occurred after the Fed's first rate hike since 2023, with Bitcoin holding near $76,500.
title: BlackRock Leads $746M Bitcoin ETF Exodus Amid Fed Rate Hike

details: Worldcoin (WLD) experienced a 12.9% decline as a deposit of 42.37 million WLD into the treasury and an unlock of over 100 million tokens created a significant supply overhang. This was further amplified by a broader risk-off sentiment in the crypto market.
title: Worldcoin (WLD) Plummets 12.9% Amid Treasury Deposit, Token Unlock

details: The crypto market has seen a three-day consecutive rise, with the NFT sector notably increasing by 8.85% in the last 24 hours. During this period, Pudgy Penguins (PENGU) rose by 13.68%, and SuperVerse (SUPER) gained 10.14%. Bitcoin (BTC) and Ethereum (ETH) also recorded slight gains, maintaining levels above $86,000 and $2,700 respectively.
sourceName: Odaily星球日报 on Binance Square
title: Crypto Market Rises, NFT Sector Jumps 8.85% in 24 Hours

details: Bitcoin Cash (BCH) saw a significant surge of 6.53% following the CME Group's announcement of regulated futures and Grayscale's filing for a BCH ETF. These developments collectively sparked a 27–30% rally for the cryptocurrency.
title: Bitcoin Cash Surges 6.53% on CME Futures, ETF News

details: The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) is currently exploring the implementation of 24/7/365 tokenized trading in collaboration with Blockchain.com. This initiative aims to leverage blockchain technology for continuous trading opportunities.
title: NYSE Explores 24/7 Tokenized Trading with Blockchain.com

details: Trueo is in the process of migrating its primary prediction-market deployment from the Base network to the Ethereum mainnet. The platform will continue to support trading and other operations on Base.
title: Trueo Shifts Prediction Market to Ethereum Mainnet from Base
